run_GTestUninitializedTest: run the GTestUninitializedTest class to verify Google Test warns when not initialized properly
test_TestExitCodeAndOutput: test the TestExitCodeAndOutput function by running a command and verifying its exit code and output
test_Assert: test the Assert function to raise AssertionError when a given condition is falsy

run_gtest_test_utils_Main: run the gtest_test_utils Main entry point to execute the Google Test uninitialized test suite
